searchText: We don't have any otel/jaeger support atm (in either kurtosis, or our devnet stack) but we can add it if its useful? @other clients - do you support tracing? 👀 oh ok thanks sam, i will try doing it manually 🤔 see if that works we had some rough regressions on our endpoints, i wonder if pandaops will do any tests against apis in the future aren’t apis tested by spec tests? no, just tests the underlying business logic, there's also no performance regression tests as I can test we embarassingly missed releasing getPendingConsolidations twice We are looking to see if it's feasible to use spectest data for integration testing of the API
